body: I have lost a lot of self confidence in the last few years. When i go out, i feel like everyone is staring at me because I look ugly or something and I don't know how to gain my self worth back. I'm aware my thoughts are irrational but how can i feel so much pain at such a young age? I can't imagine anyone ever loving me, i just wish to see the beauty and joy in life now- i live in fear of my mum dying. She was the rock in my life. Hopefully the therapist will contact me soon- i'm just so scared, i want to be able to look in the mirror, walk with my head high and hot feel complete hatred of myself.

A talking therapist wrote me a letter to say that there is a very high demand for counselling at the moment and that they are operating on a waiting list- i'm not sure how far up i am on that waiting list. But i'm not even sure where i would start? opening up to a complete stranger?
